findings.title: No-op tag/untag/rename still bumps updatedAt
findings.why: `tag`, `untag` and `rename` always call `addTag`, `removeTag` and `renameTask` with `now()`, which set `updatedAt` even when nothing changed. Examples are re-adding an existing tag, removing an absent tag, or renaming a task to its current title. `updatedAt` is documented as when the task last changed, so it can move without a real change.
